introduction: RI Works combines temporary financial support with employment and family services for eligible households with children.
description: RI Works combines temporary financial support with employment and family services for eligible households with children.

sections.who: DHS checks income, resources, residence and family circumstances. Eligible kinship guardians can ask for support for children in their care.
sections.get: Support may include cash assistance, job preparation, training, child care and transport services according to the case.
sections.docs:
• Identity, residence and income evidence.
  • Resources and household relationship records.
  • Information about work goals or participation barriers.
sections.apply:
1. Submit an application

    Use HealthyRhode or the DHS paper application route.

  2. Complete intake

    Attend the interview and return verification requests.

  3. Discuss the employment plan

    Tell the worker about child care, transport or health barriers and review the decision.
sections.after: Current RI Works changes are explained in individual Benefit Decision Notices. Follow your case’s instructions rather than an old payment table.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using RI Works overview; RI Works intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can a grandparent caregiver ask for support?
Is RI Works only a payment?
It also offers employment and supportive services.
Does submitting the form approve me?
Where should I check recent changes?
Read your specific Benefit Decision Notice and ask DHS about unclear terms.
